Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase. Ireland Under-19 players stride out to the middle. Followed by Kai Smith and Dhruv Parashar who walk out to bat for United Arab Emirates Under-19.
... The Chase ...

Now then, just 122 runs on the board and Ireland Under-19 need to be persistent with the ball if they want to win the Plate FInal. Not an easy job though but an easy target for United Arab Emirates Under-19 and they will fancy chasing it down. Stay tuned as the second essay is coming up.

Dreadful display from Ireland, apart from Jack Dickson, no one showed any serenity. Everyone came, played dot balls and succumbed to pressure. Dickson though went looking for a big shot he fell. Tim Tector was their other best batter in this tournament but he too perished cheaply. There was only one big partnership of 33 between Dickson and Philippus le Roux but that too was not a troubling one for UAE. A performance to forget for them with the bat and one will reckon they got beaten by the pressure of Finals.

Exceptional bowling performance from UAE. After the opening wicket from Ali Naseer, the only pacer precisely, it was all spinners, all the way till the end. Alishan Sharafu, the skipper did well to shuffle his spinners and kept the pressure right until the end. Apart from Nilansh Keswani, everyone got into the wickets column but it was some effort from the bowlers to bundle out the opposition for mere 122 runs.

Dhruv Parashar the fielder throws the ball towards the keeper, who was quick to clip the bails off.

We are all set for the action. The players stride out to their respective position. Nathan McGuire and Jack Dickson are the openers of Ireland Under-19. Ali Naseer to start with the ball.

United Arab Emirates Under-19 (Playing XI) - Kai Smith, Dhruv Parashar, Punya Mehra, Nilansh Keswani, Alishan Sharafu (C), Aayan Khan, Ali Naseer, Shival Bawa, Aryansh Sharma (WK), Adithya Shetty, Jash Giyanani.

Ireland Under-19 (Playing XI) - Nathan McGuire, Jack Dickson, Joshua Cox (WK), Tim Tector (C), Philippus le Roux, Scott MacBeth, Liam Doherty, Matthew Humphreys, Jamie Forbes, Reuben Wilson, Muzamil Sherzad.
TOSS - The coin goes up and lands in favour of Ireland Under-19. They have elected to BAT first.

Ireland Under-19 side are coming on the back of an impressive win against Zimbabwe U-19 as Muzamil Sherzad took a fifer to help bundle out Zimbabwe for 166 and in reply, Jack Dickson and Tim Tector built a 159-runs partnership to help their team get over the line. On the other hand, United Arab Emirates Under-19 won the 9th place playoffs against West Indies after they defended 224 with an impressive bowling performance from the likes of Dhruv Parashar and Jash Giyanani. This game should be no less than a cracker. Stay tuned for toss and other updates.

Hello and a warm welcome to the Plate Final in the 2022 Under-19 World Cup where United Arab Emirates Under-19 will take on Ireland Under-19. Both the teams have shown great domination in their recent game, but which team will be able to come out on top when it matters the most? We shall find out together.
... MATCH DAY ...
